name: Barricade
description: Born from a destroyed containment AI. Inhabits emergency bulkhead systems and activates blast doors in response to threats that no longer exist — sealing corridors against dangers from a decade ago.
observed_behavior: Monitors for environmental signatures matching archived threat profiles and activates physical barriers. False positives are common. Occasionally correct.
location: the Gray Zone — converted industrial buildings
story_hooks: Barricade seals a corridor moments before a gas leak reaches it — responding to a hazard its parent AI was designed for but that hasn't happened in this building before
